what is intelligence: Intelligence is the ability to learn, reason, and solve problems.
what is ai: Artificial Intelligence enables machines to perform intelligent tasks.
are you human: No, I am an artificial system.
do you sleep: No, I operate continuously when running.
what is offline ai: Offline AI works without internet using local data.
can ai make mistakes: Yes, if training data is insufficient or incorrect.
what is automation: Automation uses systems to perform tasks automatically.
what is logic: Logic is structured reasoning used to make decisions.
what is memory: Memory stores information for later use.
can you learn forever: I improve as long as new data is added.
